Synthetic crime-like events from a fitted Hawkes model

Source: R/data-crime.R
crimes.Rd

Simulated spatial-temporal point events provided to demonstrate fit_semihawkes. The events were generated from a semi-parametric Hawkes model fitted to previously transformed crime data from Guayaquil, Ecuador. Each row represents a simulated event, not an individual source record.

Usage

crimes

Format

An sf object with the following variables:

id

Integer. Sequential identifier for each simulated event, ordered by event time.

date

Simulated event date-time, stored as POSIXct in UTC.

geometry

Simulated POINT geometry in local Cartesian coordinates, expressed in metres.

Source

Generated for spHawkes by simulating from a semi-parametric Hawkes model, as described under Details. The model was fitted to intentional homicide records for Guayaquil, published as open data by Ecuador's Ministry of the Interior, after their coordinates and dates had been transformed. The packaged events are newly simulated rather than copies of those records.

Source of the records: Ministerio del Interior del Ecuador, Subsecretaría de Estudios y Estadística de la Seguridad. Homicidios Intencionales. Datos Abiertos Ecuador. https://www.datosabiertos.gob.ec/dataset/homicidios-intencionales?activity_id=0da52f2a-0a1e-4d0d-afa4-0fae1adab14b. Licensed under Creative Commons Attribution (CC BY).

Details

The simulation uses the fitted spatial background, long-term trend, weekly and monthly background components, and spatial and temporal triggering kernels.

Background events and their descendants were generated using a branching construction with Poisson thinning. The simulation starts with an empty event history. Descendants falling outside the observation window are discarded; events outside the window do not generate further descendants that can enter it.

Coordinates use a local Cartesian reference system, with distances expressed in metres. They do not identify the original geographic locations. Calendar dates belong to the transformed modelling timeline and should not be interpreted as dates of recorded crimes.

The dataset is intended for software examples and methodological illustration. It should not be used to draw substantive conclusions about crime patterns in the source population.

See also

crimes_region, fit_semihawkes

Examples

data("crimes")
head(crimes)
#> Simple feature collection with 6 features and 2 fields
#> Geometry type: POINT
#> Dimension:     XY
#> Bounding box:  xmin: 4908.171 ymin: 3239.169 xmax: 9871.017 ymax: 6491.946
#> Projected CRS: Local Cartesian coordinates
